slideVisualInspection: Every designed slide inspected at full size. Every final scene sampled, with key live-action/caption frames reviewed at full size. No independent human review.

sourceAudioTechnicalCheck.method: Compare a full source excerpt inside a larger decoded final-audio window. Initial fixed cropped-window normalization was unsuitable; the matched-window check confirms waveform identity and approximate placement within 100 ms. This is not ASR accuracy, human listening validation or sample-accurate screen synchronization.

limitations: Public Pages edition has no AI backend. The model responses shown are explicitly labeled historical selected cases.
